title: Make late and sparse signals evaluate honestly
description: Move the evaluation window, add delay, and change the full-window policy. The synthetic timeline shows when a monitor can evaluate and what operational state it produces.

profiles.label: Direct application metric
profiles.detail: Reports every 30s, arrives 15s late, incident began 7m ago.

profiles.label: Delayed cloud metric
profiles.detail: Reports every 5m, arrives 10m late, incident began 25m ago.

profiles.label: Sparse batch metric
profiles.detail: Reports every 10m, arrives 2m late, incident began 20m ago.

windowPolicies.label: Evaluate partial windows
windowPolicies.detail: Evaluate as soon as at least one point is available; useful for sparse streams.

windowPolicies.label: Require a full window
windowPolicies.detail: Cancel evaluation unless the oldest bucket has data and at most three minute buckets are empty.
